color.note: One deep green carries the brand; every other colour is a neutral or a status role. Status roles are reached only through the semantic aliases (status-paid-…, status-present-…) so fees, attendance and results stay consistent across all three apps.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, side panels, modals and the top bar — anything that sits on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, keypad wells, receipt paper edge, disabled inputs.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and menu-item hover on surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table rows and the active sidebar item. Text on it: ink or brand-ink.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and side panels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, secondary text, table captions on surface and surface-raised (4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and tertiary hints only; never for information the user must read.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on brand and on the dark toast surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, table rules, card edges on surface-raised.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders at rest and any border that carries meaning (3:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The MTB green: primary buttons, active sidebar mark, links, selected tabs, the campus pill. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: brand-active
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft green fill behind brand-ink: selected rows, the active nav item, stat-card icon wells.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Green text and icons on surface, surface-raised and brand-tint (links, active nav label).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand, brand-hover and brand-active.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring on every focusable control, always with a 2px offset so it sits on the surrounding surface, never on the control's own fill (≥3:1 on every surface token).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success toast icon, positive deltas on stat cards.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind success-ink.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on success-tint and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icon, due-soon markers.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning-ink; the imbalance banner on a journal voucher.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warning-tint and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, validation error borders, the Pause-all-SMS switch.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger-ink; error banners.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text under inputs, on danger-tint and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger and danger-hover.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational icons, the offline/sync indicator while syncing.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind info-ink.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-tint and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind neutral-ink: cancelled, draft, holiday and other quiet states.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-tint and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: slate-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind slate-ink (the Holiday attendance state).

tokens.name: slate-ink
tokens.usage: Text on slate-tint and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: status-paid
tokens.usage: Fees · Paid. Dot and icon colour.

tokens.name: status-paid-tint
tokens.usage: Fees · Paid badge fill.

tokens.name: status-paid-ink
tokens.usage: Fees · Paid badge text.

tokens.name: status-unpaid
tokens.usage: Fees · Unpaid (not yet due or due today).

tokens.name: status-unpaid-tint
tokens.usage: Fees · Unpaid badge fill.

tokens.name: status-unpaid-ink
tokens.usage: Fees · Unpaid badge text.

tokens.name: status-overdue
tokens.usage: Fees · Overdue (past due date, fine accruing).

tokens.name: status-overdue-tint
tokens.usage: Fees · Overdue badge fill.

tokens.name: status-overdue-ink
tokens.usage: Fees · Overdue badge text and the live late-fine figure.

tokens.name: status-cancelled
tokens.usage: Fees · Cancelled receipt or charge; pair with strikethrough on the amount.

tokens.name: status-cancelled-tint
tokens.usage: Fees · Cancelled badge fill.

tokens.name: status-cancelled-ink
tokens.usage: Fees · Cancelled badge text.

tokens.name: status-present
tokens.usage: Attendance · Present.

tokens.name: status-present-tint
tokens.usage: Attendance · Present fill (calendar cell, register row).

tokens.name: status-present-ink
tokens.usage: Attendance · Present text.

tokens.name: status-absent
tokens.usage: Attendance · Absent.

tokens.name: status-absent-tint
tokens.usage: Attendance · Absent fill.

tokens.name: status-absent-ink
tokens.usage: Attendance · Absent text.

tokens.name: status-leave
tokens.usage: Attendance · Leave (approved).

tokens.name: status-leave-tint
tokens.usage: Attendance · Leave fill.

tokens.name: status-leave-ink
tokens.usage: Attendance · Leave text.

tokens.name: status-late
tokens.usage: Attendance · Late.

tokens.name: status-late-tint
tokens.usage: Attendance · Late fill.

tokens.name: status-late-ink
tokens.usage: Attendance · Late text.

tokens.name: status-holiday
tokens.usage: Attendance · Holiday (no register expected).

tokens.name: status-holiday-tint
tokens.usage: Attendance · Holiday fill.

tokens.name: status-holiday-ink
tokens.usage: Attendance · Holiday text.

tokens.name: status-draft
tokens.usage: Results · Draft (editable, not visible to parents); badge border is dashed.

tokens.name: status-draft-tint
tokens.usage: Results · Draft badge fill.

tokens.name: status-draft-ink
tokens.usage: Results · Draft badge text.

tokens.name: status-declared
tokens.usage: Results · Declared (locked, published to the parent portal).

tokens.name: status-declared-tint
tokens.usage: Results · Declared badge fill.

tokens.name: status-declared-ink
tokens.usage: Results · Declared badge text.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series in dashboard charts (collected, present).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series (target, pending).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series and comparison baselines.

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of progress bars and meters.

type.note: Inter for English and all numerals; Noto Nastaliq Urdu for Urdu text, which always gets a taller line so the nastaliq descenders are not clipped. Both are hosted Google Fonts.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The single hero figure on a dashboard stat card or the receipt total.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles. One per page, left of the campus and session context.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Card and section headings, modal titles.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Sub-section headings, tab labels when active, table group rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Select the charges to pay, then choose a payment method.
styles.usage: Default text everywhere in the staff app, table cells included.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names, primary cell in a row, button labels.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Tap a student to mark Absent, Leave or Late.
styles.usage: Default text on the teacher app and parent portal (mobile).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a primary cell, helper text under inputs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field labels, table column headers (uppercase), badge text.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Every money and count cell: tabular figures (font-feature-settings 'tnum'), right-aligned.

styles.name: numeric-large
styles.usage: Totals in the fee counter review step and the receipt; tabular figures.

styles.name: urdu-title
styles.usage: A student's Urdu name beside the English one in the profile header and on the receipt. Always dir=rtl, lang=ur.

styles.name: urdu-body
styles.sample: محترم والدین، آپ کے بچے کی فیس واجب الادا ہے۔
styles.usage: SMS templates, notices and the parent portal when Urdu is selected. Always dir=rtl, lang=ur; never shrink the line height.

styles.name: urdu-small
styles.usage: Secondary Urdu lines: father's name under the student name, portal captions.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Receipt numbers, G.R. numbers, CNICs and voucher numbers wherever they must be read digit by digit.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Desktop tables use space-2/space-3 inside cells; mobile touch targets are never under 44px (space-11).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; badge inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge horizontal padding; gap between inline controls; tight table cell padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; input horizontal padding; gap inside a stat card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; gap between form fields; modal body padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding, gap between cards, modal body padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Control height on desktop (buttons, inputs).

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target on mobile — every button, row and keypad key on the teacher app and parent portal.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top bar height; mobile sticky action bar height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Sidebar rail width when collapsed; receipt header band.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, table row selection, keypad keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat cards, modals, side panels, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, the status dot, the campus pill in the top bar, the attendance toggle.

shadow.note: Shadows are quiet; borders do most of the separating work. Dark mode shadows are deeper because the surfaces are close in value.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and the top bar.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers, the global search results.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, side panels and toasts.
